name: 家豪 (捷運A7站 ↔ 校區 shuttle) timetable

sources.xlsx_filename: 附件_1150907起校區往返A7接駁車時刻表.xlsx

caveat.zh: 因應路況變化，實際抵達時間可能有3～5分鐘誤差或滿載時會提早駛離，敬請提早候車等候。
caveat.en: Actual arrival may be 3–5 minutes off; a full bus may leave early.

disclaimer: Static timetable transcription only. No live/GPS/ETA data.

campus_shelter.name: 校區候車亭
campus_shelter.note: xlsx header is just 校區候車亭; it does not say arrive vs depart.

corp_museum.name: 企業文物館前招呼站
corp_museum.note: On the route but has no time column; do not invent departure times.

yellow_lot.name: 校區露天停車場黃網區

not_stops.name: 林口長庚醫院
not_stops.note: Not a 家豪 stop on either official sheet. No hospital-shuttle times exist in this file; none verified.

meide_start_loop.note: Second sheet. Relation to sheet-1 trips is not stated by the source; do not merge or dedupe.

peak_rule.offpeak: Trips marked ＊ in the xlsx detour via 明德 (offpeak_detour_loop).

exception.rule: Skip 校區露天停車場黃網區, 長庚科大公車站牌前, 科大三舍, 明德樓 (direct_loop).

peak_rule.sun_holiday_note: Sun/holiday ＊ marks appear only on 16:35, 17:05, 17:35 (these have 明德 times). 18:05–21:35 have no ＊ and no 明德 time, so detours_via_meide=false as in the xlsx, even though 18:35–21:35 is inside the stated off-peak window. Encoded literally; not resolved.

friday_and_preholiday_extras.rule: ◎以下專車僅於星期例假日前夕行駛 (sheet header: 週五(Fri)加班車). Source gives no holiday calendar; this file does not define which dates are 例假日前夕.

sun_holiday.note: Earliest listed A7 departure is 16:35. No morning Sun/holiday trips are listed; none invented.

saturday.note: xlsx has only Mon–Fri and 星期(例假)日 columns; Saturday is not stated. Do not assume service or no service. Exception: 2026-11-21 override.

rules.day_before: Run the Friday schedule (星期五班次).
rules.last_day: Run the Sunday schedule (星期日班次).

winter_summer_break.note: Special winter/summer-break table NOT found on the official traffic page or traffic-management list as of 2026-11-21. Unknown whether service differs; no times encoded.

overrides.warning: Valid on 2026-11-21 only. Never use as the regular Sunday/holiday table; ignore on any other date.
notes: ＊17:05 教職員專車 (第一醫學大樓→A7站2號出口) runs as normal; it is a staff shuttle, not a general shelter trip, and is not encoded as a trip.
